text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's that time of year once again!
The first leg of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho! All eyes are on Mihono Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
There were concerns about her distance aptitude,
but she blew them right away!
She should have no problem running 2,000 meters!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Even when compared to last year's winner, Tokai Teio,
her raw talent does not pale in comparison.
Expectations are running high!
The entire venue was buzzing with excitement over Mihono Bourbon's race entry. Meanwhile, in the underground paddock tunnel—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But... Rice... Rice wants to too...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Go, Rice, Rice, you can do it...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, u-umm, I was just so happy to be running with you today, that, well...

—And Rice Shower reached out
her trembling hand toward Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
I-I'm so sorry, someone like Rice shouldn't have...!

—And Mihono Bourbon gently grasped
Rice Shower's hand just as she was about to pull it back.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you, Rice Shower-san.
The curtain rises on the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown races, the Satsuki Sho!
